billing-bot: Payment failure detected for BrightCo (acct BR-993). Autopay charge $12,400 failed via card. decline_code: do_not_honor. attempt=1
Maya (Billing Ops): saw it, looks like issuer blocked after their billing contact upgrade. Customer on Dedicated plan — high churn risk.
Jordan (Acct Mgmt): I messaged their PO, they said new billing card is incoming but not yet added.
Sam (Finance): we currently only try once on autopay, right? can we set a retry schedule (24h, 48h, 72h) + notify billing contact each attempt?
Maya (Billing Ops): yes please. Also surface a wire option in the email if card stays failing. Will need finance okay to add manual wire instructions in invoice.
Sam (Finance): approved to include wire instructions and a one-time payment link. set invoice -> pending-retry, retries: 3, interval: 24h.
Nora (Support): I'll draft the customer message and include a secure pay link. Draft: "Hi BrightCo — your autopay for $12,400 didn’t go through. You can update your card here: https://pay.redwood.com/invoice/BR-993 or pay by wire (details below). Let me know if you want us to retry autopay." :email:
Jordan (Acct Mgmt): please make it clear wire is manual and may take 1-2 business days to clear. They asked for invoice copy + remittance details.
Maya (Billing Ops): internal wire snippet for ops (do not post publicly):
```
Bank: Redwood Bank Corp
Routing: 021000021
Account: 123456789
Ref: BR-993 / BrightCo
```
Sam (Finance): works for me. add note to invoice: "Wire instructions provided upon request; autopay will retry 3x at 24h intervals. If still failing, account hold escalation to AM."
billing-bot: Created retry schedule (3 attempts). Ticket #24567. Next retry scheduled at +24h from 1961234567.
Nora (Support): sending message now and attaching invoice + pay link. cc @Jordan.
Jordan (Acct Mgmt): confirmed — I'll follow up personally if no payment after second retry. :thumbsup:
Maya (Billing Ops): action items: 1) Nora send message (done) 2) Sam confirm wire template in finance KB 3) Ops use ticket #24567 if manual reconciliation needed.
Sam (Finance): I'll add the wire template to KB and flag for reconciliation.
billing-bot: Update: retry created, status: pending-retry. Will post updates in this thread when attempts occur.
